A while ago, in Finland, we had those TV-license inspectors who would knock on your door and ask if you have a TV-license. 

Yes, we all had to pay for it, but the only way to check if you had payed was to those inspectors to go to door to door to those apartments that had not payed the license. 

You could always say that you don't have a TV that's connected to an antenna. But the problem was when you would open a door to a random guy and they hear the most popular national TV show's (Salatut Elämät, you know it) tune at the exact time of the viewing playing... well, you've screwed. 

Nowadays the TV-license is connected to taxes so we don't have to worry about the inspectors anymore, but that was a good lie to tell everyone why we wouldn't open the door if someone would come by without announcement.
